name: 픽셀 값 차분 분석
description: Detects stego-like pixel value differencing patterns that leak into AI-generated images (Wu & Tsai, 2003).
mechanism:
이 방법은 applies Pixel Value Differencing (PVD) analysis following Wu & Tsai (2003) for steganographic and manipulation detection:

1. **블록Partitioning**: The image is divided into non-overlapping blocks of two consecutive pixels. For each block, the difference value dₖ = |pᵢ − pᵢ₊₁| is computed between adjacent pixel pairs in both horizontal and vertical directions.

2. **Difference히스토그램Construction**: A histogram of all pixel difference values is constructed. Natural images exhibit a characteristic PVD histogram following a Laplacian-like distribution — high concentration near zero (smooth regions) with exponential decay toward larger differences (edge regions).

3. **RangeTable분석**: Differences are classified into ranges [lₖ, uₖ] following the PVD range table. Each range has an expected capacity proportional to its width. Steganographic embedding modifies the histogram within these ranges in detectable ways — creating artifacts in the distribution tails.

4. **통계적Regularity감지**: 본 방법은 detects statistical anomalies in the PVD histogram: (a) unnatural steps between adjacent bins caused by embedding algorithms, (b) abnormal symmetry or flatness in 일반적으로 peaked distributions, (c) deviations from the expected Benford-like first-digit distribution of differences.

5. **AIGenerationIndicators**: AI 생성 images 일반적으로 exhibit PVD histograms with abnormal smoothness (lacking the fine-grained irregularities of real camera quantization), unusual uniformity across difference ranges, or artificial periodicity absent in natural pixel statistics. The analysis score quantifies these deviations.
parameters: 분석 유형: 자동 통계\n점수 범위: 0(실제)~100(AI 생성)
source: 디지털 포렌식 및 AI 콘텐츠 탐지 관련 동료 검토 연구 기반.
useCase: AI 생성 콘텐츠를 탐지하기 위한 다중 신호 분석 파이프라인의 일부로 사용.
strengths: • 연구 기반 방법론\n• 빠른 계산 속도\n• 다른 탐지 방법과 보완적
limitations: • 정확도는 입력 품질에 따라 변동\n• 다른 방법과 함께 사용하는 것이 최적

references.title: Wu, D.C. & Tsai, W.H. (2003). A Steganographic Method for Images by Pixel-Value Differencing. Pattern Recognition Letters.
Fridrich, J. et al. (2001). Detecting LSB Steganography in Color and Gray-Scale Images. IEEE Multimedia.
